environment.note: Shared cloud container. Absolute times are NOT comparable across sessions; only within-process comparisons are treated as signal.

fixture.statistic: median of 7, best of 2 interleaved blocks

enabled_overhead.method: within-process, interleaved trace-off / trace-on blocks in the same binary
enabled_overhead.note: App::FeatureTest executes in roughly 7-11 microseconds, so the relative figure here is close to a worst case. A feature taking 1 ms would see roughly 0.1 percent.

disabled_overhead.method: cross-build: instrumented binary with trace off vs binary rebuilt with the Document.cpp hooks reverted
disabled_overhead.note: Cross-run variance within a single configuration reaches ~18 percent on this container, which exceeds the difference between configurations. The honest claim is 'below the noise floor', not 'zero'.
